attribution.note: Zitron states this in his own voice.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves both antecedents and the historical status of the cited ratios.

contract.note: Comparing capital spending with additional cloud revenue is an ordinary reading. Baseline, aggregation and margin definitions remain consequential interpretations.

evidence.note: This dated company announcement indicates Anthropic activity in October 2026. It establishes neither five-year survival nor the financial comparison.

reviews.rationale: The July 2031 deadline remains ahead. Neither antecedent is established for the full interval, and the packet contains no qualifying early-resolution event or completed financial comparison.

attribution.note: The spending forecast is Zitron's own assertion.

semantics.note: The normalization faithfully isolates the definite 2026 spending forecast from the separate statement about 2027 plans.

contract.note: The surrounding paragraph reasonably identifies the companies and cumulative baseline. Requiring realized spending attributable to generative AI follows the wording.

evidence.note: The report is available before the cutoff but forecasts capex for six companies through a different period. It supplies no comparable realized generative-AI spending total.

reviews.rationale: December 31, 2026 has not arrived. The packet does not establish realized, attributable cumulative spending above $1.3 trillion, so the early-support rule is unmet. Projected capex cannot settle the forecast.

attribution.note: Zitron personally endorses the prediction of financing difficulty.

semantics.note: The financing-difficulty prediction is firm; the possibility of a signed deal is separately hedged. The metadata's 'unlikely' modality misdescribes the firm main clause.

contract.note: Material financing difficulty is an ordinary reading of the firm prediction. Failed attempts, delays and burdensome terms are reasonable indicators, though their thresholds are evaluator supplied.

evidence.note: NVIDIA discloses contingent credit support. This is relevant financing context, but neither proceeds for both specified uses nor evidence establishing the difficulty of raising them.

reviews.rationale: The main prediction is firm despite the separate concession that a deal might occur. No deadline is stated. The guarantee does not satisfy the conclusive-event rule or establish whether the specified financing involved material difficulty.

attribution.note: The financial-benefit assessment is Zitron's own; the quoted performance slogan is background.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the retrospective assessment, profitability scope, monetary measurability qualifier and repeated appearance hedge.

contract.note: The contract converts a hedged assessment into a scoreable universal absence claim. The plain-reading exception explicitly does not permit scoring hedged language.

evidence.note: The timely manufacturer report supplies reported monetary unit-cost reductions, countering the cost component. It is commercially interested evidence and establishes neither startup profitability nor an isolated hardware effect.

reviews.rationale: The repeated appearance qualifier makes this a hedged assessment that policy excludes from scoring. Reported deployment savings challenge the cost component, while profitability remains unestablished; neither permits overriding the hedge.
